identity: Haute Couture::Le Noir Brand Manager Don Quixote
frame_numbering: Zero-based source decoded frames; intervals are [start,end). Seconds = frame*1001/30000.
measurement_policy: Body height H excludes antlers, hammer, hair trails and VFX; dimensions/distances are screen-space estimates, usually ±0.5 H or ±25%, not world-space measurements. Palette hex values are visual approximations, not original asset colors.
mapping_policy: No skill labels or coin UI in this trailer. Named mappings are hypotheses from the supplied kit, counts and motifs. The supplied kit itself warns of paraphrase risk. Distinguish visible contact events from inferred game coins; do not force equality.
timing_policy: Every gameplay source frame 315–1960 inspected in native-rate sheets. Overviews cover the entire file at 6 fps. Frame-accurate refers to visible pose/effect/cut onset; exact physical contact can be occluded and is bracketed where necessary.
skill_name_candidate: Summoneth the Nail (guard and response candidate)
mapping_evidence: 44.511 and 45.345 are visibly enemy attacks into a golden guard held in front of Don, not outgoing S1.
After a brief upright reset, Don summons nails and performs two distinct hammer-contact flashes. Three visible outgoing events conflict with supplied two coins.
Possible compound: Judgment! (one coin) followed by Witness Ye in Silence (two coins). No UI or separating cut establishes this split. Keep all events rather than force a two-hit count.

weapon.parts: Two heavy faceted cylindrical/drum striking heads joined by a narrow central collar; long thin shaft with banded, capped butt. Rectangular inset/rib outlines on the drums. Not three separate floating blocks.
weapon.held: Same hammer upright above/behind Don while blocking; a separate golden translucent angular crescent/plate stands in front of her. Then hammer is lowered for nail cast and shouldered for two sweeps.

evidence.observation: Hammer head next to enemy, continuous thin haft back to Don.
One gloved hand grips shaft across shoulder; capped butt above right.
Both drums and center collar visible behind shoulder.
One visible hand low on shaft during final strike.

props.appearance: Pale gold angular outlines, transparent center with dark areas; halo/plate shape, not proof of a physical tower shield.

props.origin: Materialize in air above the target; not launched out of the held hammer.
props.path: Two downward points develop from ragged gold streaks, hover separated, then plunge inward to converge in a V at the target.
props.appearance: T/crossbar head, tapered shaft/point; white-yellow core, gold edge/glow; pointed silhouette is not evidence of a sword grip or blade.

props.residue: V-shaped pair remains at target after plunge; floor ring is aftermath of the same event.

props.path: Lagging behind live Don during hammer rush; transparent orange silhouettes, no independent attack.
